title: Length
prompt: Return how long the vector is: the straight-line distance from (0, 0) to its tip. Vector2(3, 4) has length 5.
starter:
func solve(v: Vector2) -> float:
	return v.x + v.y
hint: Vectors have a length method; no need for the square-root formula.
solution:
func solve(v: Vector2) -> float:
	return v.length()
